result:
This is my favorite writing advice I tell myself and others. Writing is not a didactic activity like some say. Writing is not as simple as talking. Writing is a technique of sharing and organizing thoughts because it is best to remember when I need it. Once you get it all out, it's destiny that will take the words to places they belong. 

Once the 1000 words had been written, I was able to fit my weekly content into the schedule I had planned. It's not hard, just paint first and be honest about what words you release into the world.
